name: Team Squirtle: Aerial Tides & Volt Quakes
archetype: Water/Flying aerial anchors, Levitate special sweepers, and Electric/Ground sweepers.
gym_duel_rationale: Blaine's team wields aggressive Fire sweepers backed by Ground and Flying coverage. Enter his 4v4 arena with Blastoise/Fearow (Water/Flying aerial anchor that resists Fire while enjoying complete immunity to Ground moves, dousing Fire leads with STAB Hydro Pump), Jolteon/Sandslash (blazing Electric/Ground sweeper that outspeeds Charizard/Aerodactyl and deletes it with STAB Thunderbolt, while flattening grounded Fire types with STAB Earthquake), Alakazam/Weezing (Levitate makes it completely immune to Magmar/Rhydon's Drill Run while dismantling foes with 118 SpA Psychic), and Snorlax (Thick Fat halving all Fire attacks, providing an unbreakable defensive bastion).

roster.progression_notes: 515 BST Water/Flying titan. Resists Fire, Water, Fighting, and Bug, with total immunity to Ground Earthquake and Drill Run. Washes away Blaine's Fire sweepers with high-powered Hydro Pumps.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Levitate completely negates Ground attacks, allowing it to safely bypass Magmar/Rhydon's Drill Run while boosting with Calm Mind.

490 BST Electric/Ground terror with 105 Speed and 100 Attack. STAB Discharge electrifies flying and water targets with 30% paralysis chance, while STAB Earthquake crushes Ninetales/Arcanine and Magmar/Rhydon.
475 BST Intimidate breaker. Lowers enemy Attack upon entry. Glare paralyzes fast Fire threats, while Close Combat shatters Rock splices.
540 BST colossal tank. Thick Fat halves incoming Fire moves, turning Blaine's Charcoal-boosted Fire Blasts into trivial damage.
535 BST bulky water artillery with 130 HP. Fires off high-power Hydro Pumps to overwhelm Fire switch-ins outside of sunlight.

flex_bench.rationale: Chlorophyll Sleep Powder support and special tank (Bulbasaur family).
Intimidate Dragon Dance sweeper with Aqua Tail (Magikarp family).
Technician Rapid Spin utility from Fighting Dojo (Tyrogue family).
